features.name: Berkeley registry database download
features.summary: Shell script curls the Voluntary Registry Offsets Database v2026-06 xlsx (CC BY 4.0) into data/raw.

features.name: TF-IDF cross-registry candidate screening
features.summary: Per-country character 3-4-gram TF-IDF cosine similarity at 0.62 keeps pairs from different registries and computes overlapping issued vintages and volume (smaller side).
features.registry_match: TF-IDF candidate matching and local LLM review

features.name: Transparent pre-score and capacity conflict check
features.summary: Weights name, developer, location, type similarity and subtracts a penalty when stated MW capacities conflict, to order pairs before LLM review.
features.registry_match: TF-IDF candidate matching and local LLM review

features.name: Local LLM same-asset adjudication (Gemma via llama.cpp)
features.summary: Sends both records to a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint at temperature 0 with a JSON schema, returning yes/no/unclear, confidence and transfer flag; resumable cache in verdicts.jsonl.
features.registry_match: TF-IDF candidate matching and local LLM review

features.name: Evidence-bound second-pass verification
features.summary: Second LLM pass lists shared facts; code drops any value not found as a whole phrase in both records and confirms only with yes/yes and at least two surviving facts.
features.registry_match: TF-IDF candidate matching and local LLM review

features.name: Findings report with name-conflict and number checks
features.summary: Builds findings.json, keeps the model reason only if its numbers appear in both records, and excludes pairs whose names carry different numbers or distinguishing words.

features.name: Merkle tree over findings with per-finding proofs
features.summary: Hashes each finding into a keccak sorted-pair Merkle tree, stores leaf and proof per finding and the root in the summary, with a self-check; it does not itself submit a transaction.

features.name: CreditClaimRegistry Solidity contract
features.summary: Owner adds registry operators and auditors; registries record issuances per listing and vintage.

features.name: Smart-contract double-issuance guard
features.summary: After an auditor links two listings as one asset, a different registry issuing an already-issued vintage reverts with DoubleIssuance; existing overlaps emit ConflictDetected.

features.name: Retirement cap
features.summary: retire() reverts with OverRetirement if the amount exceeds what is left and only the issuing registry may retire.

features.name: On-chain report root anchoring and Merkle verification
features.summary: anchorReport stores roots and verifyFinding checks sorted-pair proofs; exercised only on in-memory/in-browser EVMs, with no testnet or mainnet deployment in the repo.

features.name: solc-js compile pipeline
features.summary: Compiles contracts/src with solc (Cancun EVM) and writes ABI plus bytecode to contracts/out and web/public/contract.

features.name: In-memory ethereumjs EVM harness
features.summary: createChain deploys and calls contracts on a Cancun VM with deterministic demo accounts, shared by the tests and the browser demo.

features.name: Findings dashboard (stats, filters, table, detail)
features.summary: Static Vite page with headline stats, registry-pair chips, overlap filter, findings table and per-finding detail (mirrored vintage chart, shared facts, listing cards).

features.name: In-browser finding-vs-root inclusion check
features.summary: Recomputes the leaf and folds the proof to compare against the published Merkle root.

features.name: Five-step in-browser contract demo
features.summary: Deploys the compiled bytecode to an in-browser EVM, replays both registries' issuances, links the listings, shows the DoubleIssuance revert and anchors/verifies the report root.

features.name: CI test and GitHub Pages deploy
features.summary: Workflow runs Python unittest, npm compile, npm test and vite build, then deploys dist to GitHub Pages.

features.name: Node contract and report tests
features.summary: Eight registry tests plus three report-integrity tests (matches the README count of eleven); not executed by the audit.

features.name: Python pipeline unit tests
features.summary: Tests for capacity normalization, name cleaning, fact grounding, name-conflict and cached-verdict handling.

features.name: Shipped screening and model output data
features.summary: Repo includes candidates.json (1,989 pairs), verdicts.jsonl, evidence.jsonl, projects.json.gz and findings.json with summary 11,468 listings, 450 adjudicated, 18 shared-vintage pairs and 2,486,944 tCO2e overlap, matching the README and registry.
features.registry_match: Demo scan: 18 shared-vintage pairs, about 2.49M tCO₂e

features.name: Demo video
features.summary: carbontwin-demo.mp4 is shipped in web/public/media and dist; not played.

features.name: Docstring drift in screen.py
features.summary: screen.py header says it writes data/projects.parquet but the code writes projects.json.gz.

limits: Did not execute the pipeline, tests, Vite build or any contract.
Did not run or re-derive the LLM verdicts; adjudication results in data/*.jsonl were taken as shipped.
Did not read web/src/style.css, dist/, LICENSE or package-lock.json, and did not play the demo video.
No hardcoded secrets found; demo EVM account keys are derived from fixed strings in contracts/chain.mjs, a deterministic test-only derivation.
